target.label: Adjusted net product revenue
target.description: Weekly net product revenue (product sales minus product returns, GBP for the built-in data), with documented forecasting-only corrections applied. The dashboard's 'Net product revenue' is the same figure without those corrections.
target.week: Monday to Sunday; complete weeks only

series.name: SET/5 RED RETROSPOT LID GLASS BOWLS
HOT WATER BOTTLE TEA AND SYMPATHY

product_selection.rule: Net sales in >= 75% of the selection window's 58 trading weeks and a sale in its first week; top 20 by net product revenue between 2009-12-07 and 2011-01-30 (selection window only).

corrections.rule: Manual credit on a cancellation invoice that exactly reverses one, and only one, product-sale line of the same customer within 30 minutes (value >= 1,000).
corrections.rationale: The reversal was booked with the non-product code M, so under the approved policy it sits outside net product revenue while the sale it reverses stays inside. For forecasting only, the reversal is applied to the product and the business total; the dashboard and stored transactions are unchanged.
